senses.gloss: (b. h.; denom. of מֶרֶד; cmp. מָעַל a. מַעַל)to rebel, refuse obedience; to protest.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 5:7">Keth. V, 7</cite> <he>המוֹרֶדֶת על בעלה</he> she who rebels against her husband (refusing marital duties; oth. opin. refusing to work).
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 5:7">Ib.</cite> <he>המוֹרֵד על אשתו</he> a husband refusing marital duties (oth. opin. refusing to give her work and support); ib. 63ᵇ.
<cite ref="Megillah 13a:8">Meg. 13ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ בעצת מרגלים</he> he (Caleb) protested against the counsel of the spies.

<cite ref="Megillah 13a:8">Ib.</cite> <he>מרדה בגילולי וכ׳</he> she refused homage to the idols of her father’s house; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maaser Sheni 1:1:19">Y. Maas. Sh. I, 52ᵈ</cite> top <he>מטבע שמרד</he>, read: <he>של מֶרֶד</he> or <cite ref="M02572"><he>מָרוֹד</he></cite>, q. v.]
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 23:7">Gen. R. s. 23</cite>, v. infra.

senses.gloss: to make rebellious, to incite. Y. Keth. V, 30ᵇ bot. התורה הִמְרַדְתָּהּ עליו the Law requires her to be rebellious against him (to refuse sexual connection).
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 26:4">Gen. R. s. 26</cite> <he>זה הִמְרִידָן עלי</he> this man (Nimrod) made them rebel against me; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 26:4">ib.</cite> s. 23 <he>זה המוֹרְדָן עלי</he> (‘Rashi’: <he>המרידן</he>).
